tier1.headline: Your data shared commercially
tier1.quote: With business partners, service vendors, authorized third-party agents, or contractors to provide a requested website, Solution, service, or transaction.

tier1.headline: Your data trains AI
tier1.quote: Automated methods are often used to assist our manual methods in accordance with applicable laws.

tier1.headline: Your data collected without account
tier1.quote: If you choose to provide Cisco with a third party's Personal Data (such as name, email, and phone number), you represent that you have the third party's permission to do so.

tier2.headline: Your DNT requests are ignored
tier2.quote: Our third-party partners may use cookies or similar technologies to provide you with advertising based on your browsing activities and interests. Where this type of third party advertising is disabled, generic, non-personalized ads will continue to be displayed.

tier2.headline: Your data shared broadly within Cisco
tier2.quote: Within Cisco and any of our worldwide subsidiaries for the purposes of data processing, such as marketing, business operations, compliance, security, website or Solution functionality, or storage.

tier2.headline: Your data kept for business needs
tier2.quote: We will retain and use your Personal Data as necessary to comply with our business requirements and legal obligations, resolve disputes, protect our assets, and enforce our rights and agreements.

tier2.headline: Your precise location is collected
tier2.quote: These tools collect certain standard information that your browser sends to us (such as Internet Protocol [IP] address, MAC address, clickstream behavior, and telemetry).

tier2.headline: Your data used for targeted ads
tier2.quote: Our third-party partners may use cookies or similar technologies to provide you with advertising based on your browsing activities and interests.

tier2.headline: Your data transferred internationally
tier2.quote: As Cisco is a global organization, Personal Data may be transferred to Cisco in the United States of America, to any Cisco subsidiary worldwide, or to third parties and business partners as described above that are located in various jurisdictions around the world.

tier2.headline: Your data shared with authorities
tier2.quote: With law enforcement officials, government authorities, or other third parties as necessary to comply with legal process or meet national security requirements; protect the rights, property, or safety of Cisco, our business partners, you, or others; or as otherwise required by applicable law.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights are restricted
tier2.quote: In some cases, we may not be able to remove all Personal Data and comments.
